title: UART Receive
text: Receive data from the Universal Asynchronous Receiver Transmitter (UART) port, 2 outputs, {Data type} sets Type of data to be received; {UART module}, {Additional package header} sets the prefix header, {Additional package terminator} sets the suffix terminator E, {Data length} sets the size of data to be received, {Enable blocking mode} and {Sample time} sets the interval at which block reads data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Data type
params.values: Type of data to be received uint8 (default) | double | single | int8 | int8 | int16 | int32 | uint32 | boolean

params.name: Data length
params.values: Size of data to be received 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Enable blocking mode
params.values: Enable blocking mode for data transmission off (default) | on

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Interval at which block reads data 0.1 (default)
